producer_report.summary: Introspection of a rejected or failed job now gives the model the job's stored verification. event_of_job appends `verification_text(&Verification)` to `what`. That function lists the text of each unmet criterion, each blocker or major finding (severity, location, summary), and, under a separate 'Failed checks' heading, each failed check with its name, exit code and output tail. Counts are capped at 6 per list, text at 400 chars, and the check tail at 800 chars. A failed check is never listed as a criterion. The system prompt now says criteria and checks differ and to use the listed items. A job without verification.json keeps the old `what`. The existing prompt redaction covers the added text. I added four unit tests, updated the module doc, defaults-loop.md section 3.3, decision-sets.md and CHANGELOG.md. Last runs: `cargo test --locked` passed. Clippy was clean before the final doc-comment edit. After that edit I ran `cargo fmt --all`, not `--check`.

checks_run.note: run with -q; every test result ok, 0 failed
run before the last doc-comment edit; clean

open_issues: event_of_job itself (git-backed) has no direct test. The tests cover verification_text and the prompt it feeds; the no-verification case is the unchanged code path (Option is None), with no dedicated test.
Criterion 5 is covered by a fake-shaped test (unmet criterion 8 text and major finding location in the prompt), not by loading the real 2r9b verification.json, which is absent from this snapshot.
mistakes: The first changelog edit failed because the 'Changed' heading is not unique; fixed with a longer anchor.
learnings: The whole user prompt is redacted later in introspect(), so text added to the event's `what` is covered.
JobRecords.verification is Option<Verification> (store.rs); Verification deserializes with deny_unknown_fields, so tests build it from full JSON.
desires: Read access to Bash tool-result files, so large test output can be searched.
